headline: The mountain is erupting
lede: VOLCANO joined the demos shelf: a night eruption raymarched in WebGL2 — lava channels flowing down a dark cone, an ash plume lit from within, a fountain of embers, and heat shimmer rising off the vent, with synthesized rumble and blasts.

notes.text: One raymarch pass does the cone, the lava (vent-LOS lighting walks toward the crater and paints the slopes), and a wind-sheared ash plume with below-lighting and occasional internal lightning.
The ember fountain is a deterministic closed-form ballistic sim — the harness can replay any particle at any time and check it against v + gravity.

The shimmer gate caught a real bug: the vent's screen-space projection used view-z where clip-w belongs, so the shimmer mask was projected 46 screens up. A state hook printing the projected point pinned it in one probe.
A frozen test frame must freeze the camera lerp too — once it did, the shimmer toggle finally proved load-bearing (per-pixel differential, mutant goes red).
